entities.summary: One of history's most powerful empires (c. 1299–1922), spanning southeastern Europe, western Asia, and northern Africa at its height. The Ottoman conquest of Constantinople (1453) ended the Byzantine Empire, and the empire remained a major world power for 400 years.
